sections.Profile:
"Bow and Arrow," released by Bally in November 1975, is a four-player electro-mechanical game with score reels, designed by Greg Kmiec with artwork by Christian Marche and built in a run of 7,630 units.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Western, Original Theme, 1970s, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Design: Greg Kmiec
sections.Editions: - Bow and Arrow: 7,630 made, released 1975-11-01, model number 1033
